entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your study of heroes and combat has made you exceptionally suited for directing allies to their most advantageous positions.

Prerequisite(s): Inspire action class feature.

Benefit(s): When using the inspire action ability to grant an extra move action, you can affect all allies within 30 feet.
